svg.text: Does our 19-task subset track the full benchmark?
Not a harness result: each dot is an existing public leaderboard entry, re-scored on just our 19 tasks. 22 of 26 land within ±5 points.
above the line: subset scores higher
Pass rate across all leaderboard entries, hard → easy
Treat gaps under ~5 points between two harnesses
Source: public Terminal-Bench 4.0 leaderboard, all trials of 26 entries (15 models; Opus 5 / max excluded — trial records don't match its published score). The subset is scored from the same trials.

Average gap 3.2 points, rank agreement 0.93; against only the other 47 tasks (no shared trials): 4.6 points, 0.90. The ±5-point band is a visual guide, not a confidence interval. Chosen with this leaderboard in view.
